title: What's New: Business Central User Experience and Productivity (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction and Business Central icon updates
Agent task pane and system columns
Review bar and demo of agent features

features.name: Updated Business Central icon
features.description: New Business Central icon aligned with Microsoft design updates across all products, visible in browser, mobile app, and Teams app.

features.name: Dedicated agent task pane
features.description: New task pane separated from the main experience for managing agent activities, including built-in sales order and payables agents and custom agents.

features.name: Sales order agent
features.description: Built-in agent for sales orders that can be used directly in Business Central.

features.name: Payables agent
features.description: Built-in agent for payables that can be used directly in Business Central.

features.name: Custom agents capability
features.description: Ability to build custom agents in Business Central through partners or users.

features.name: Created/updated by system columns
features.description: New system columns on lists showing who created and who modified records, particularly useful for documents created by agents.

features.name: Review bar for agent changes
features.description: Review bar that appears when a document requires human review or was changed by an agent, showing what was changed and when.

features.name: Cancel all agent tasks action
features.description: New action in the task pane to cancel all agent tasks at once, useful if an agent is misconfigured or stuck with many tasks.
caveats: more actions coming in future updates

features.name: Enhanced feedback experience
features.description: New feedback button in product areas allowing customers to provide detailed comments, attach screenshots and documents to send feedback about their Business Central experience.
